full_judgment:
5. Mr. M. A. Wahhab Miah learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits only one point, namely, that the courts below as well as the High Court Division committed an error of law in not holding that the suit is barred by limitation having not been filed within 12 years from the admitted date of dispossession in the year 1971. 

 6. The courts below as well as the High Court Division appears to have rightly rejected this contention of the petitioner in view of the admitted position that the suit property was released by the Government on 13.4.76 in favour of the plaintiffs vendor, Mahboob Hossain, whose ownership had been accepted by the concerned authority and as such the period the property had been under the management of the Government as abandoned property can-not be tagged with the period of limitation of 12 years. The suit having been filed on 10.8.86 well within the period of 12 years from 13.4.76 is not barred by limitation.
